text: A psalme for to confesse. Be ye ioyfull in God all that be in the earth:
serue God with gladnesse, and come before his face with a ioyfull noyse.
Be ye sure that God is the Lorde, it is he that hath made vs, and not we our selues: we are his people and the sheepe of his pasture.
Go your way into his gates with thankesgeuyng, and into his courtes with prayse: be thankfull vnto hym and blesse his name.
For God is gratious, his mercie is euerlastyng: and his trueth endureth from generation to generation.
